sources.title: Extremal Sidon Sets are Fourier Uniform, with Applications to Partition Regularity
sources.publication: Journal de Théorie des Nombres de Bordeaux 35 (2023), 115–134
sources.historical_inspection: The modular proof author checked the journal source; the independent modular audit inspected Theorem 1.2 on printed page 116 and Theorem 1.15 beginning on printed page 118.
sources.scope: Theorem 1.15 explicitly assumes at least five nonzero-coefficient variables and a nonempty zero-sum coefficient subset; its direct conclusion does not apply to the four-variable equation a+b+c=d. No result from the paper is a premise of the finite-group theorems.
sources.pdf_byte_identity: No verified full-PDF hash/size is recorded in the accepted modular audit inputs; none is invented here.
sources.method_limit: The applicability check does not rule out other Fourier arguments.
